#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    int maxL = -1;
    int nwi = 0;
    int fp = 0;
    int fw = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '(':
                fp++;
                fw = 0;
                break;
            case ')':
                if (fp == 1 && fw != 0) {
                    nwi++;
                }
                fp--;
                fw = 0;
                break;
            case '_':
                if (fp == 1 && fw != 0) {
                    nwi++;
                }
                fw = 0;
                break;
            default:
                fw++;
                break;
        }
        if (fp == 0) {
            maxL = max(fw, maxL);
        }
        i++;
    }
    cout << maxL << " " << nwi << endl;
    return 0;
}
